<module id="freq_div">
    <description>Frequency divider for generating 50MHz, 10MHz, and 1MHz clocks from a 100MHz input clock.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="CLK_in">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal.</input>
        <output id="CLK_50">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 2.</output>
        <output id="CLK_10">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 10.</output>
        <output id="CLK_1">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 100.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="DIV_50">50</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIV_10">10</parameter>
        <parameter id="DIV_1">1</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <reg id="cnt_50" type="sequential_logic">Counter for generating 50MHz clock.</reg>
        <reg id="cnt_10" type="sequential_logic">Counter for generating 10MHz clock.</reg>
        <reg id="cnt_100" type="sequential_logic">Counter for generating 1MHz clock.</reg>
        <wire id="CLK_50_out" type="combinational_logic">Output signal for 50MHz clock.</wire>
        <wire id="CLK_10_out" type="combinational_logic">Output signal for 10MHz clock.</wire>
        <wire id="CLK_1_out" type="combinational_logic">Output signal for 1MHz clock.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge CLK_in or negedge RST) begin
            if (!RST) begin
                cnt_50 <= 0;
                cnt_10 <= 0;
                cnt_100 <= 0;
                CLK_50_out <= 0;
                CLK_10_out <= 0;
                CLK_1_out <= 0;
            end else begin
                cnt_50 <= cnt_50 + 1;
                if (cnt_50 == DIV_50 - 1) begin
                    CLK_50_out <= ~CLK_50_out;
                    cnt_50 <= 0;
                end

                cnt_10 <= cnt_10 + 1;
                if (cnt_10 == DIV_10 - 1) begin
                    CLK_10_out <= ~CLK_10_out;
                    cnt_10 <= 0;
                end

                cnt_100 <= cnt_100 + 1;
                if (cnt_100 == DIV_1 - 1) begin
                    CLK_1_out <= ~CLK_1_out;
                    cnt_100 <= 0;
                end
            end
        end

        assign CLK_50 = CLK_50_out;
        assign CLK_10 = CLK_10_out;
        assign CLK_1 = CLK_1_out;
    </implementation>
</module>
